creator: Alexander Terp
description:
From #153, batch 12, item 3.

```rad
args:
    json j bool

command dep:
    ---
    Deployments.
    ---
    command list:
        ---
        List them.
        ---
        name str
        default
        calls do_list

fn do_list():
    print("json={json} name={name}")
```

On main:

```
rad ns.rad dep list -j x   ->  json=true  name=x
rad ns.rad dep -j list x   ->  json=false name=x   (exit 0)
rad ns.rad dep -j x        ->  json=false name=x   (exit 0)
```

The flag is accepted and thrown away with no error (`-j dep x` is correctly rejected). It should either bind, as namespace args do from any position, or be rejected.

Separately, an arg declared on the namespace itself works from any position but is missing from `dep -h` and `dep list -h`, which list only the script-level flags. Each `-h` should list the args it inherits from the namespaces above it.
title: A script-level flag placed after a namespace is accepted and silently dropped
